rules.description: The bar's whole range is enclosed by the previous bar's, on the inclusive boundary — Grimes's volatility-contraction bar.

complexity.reason: a two-bar comparison at fixed offsets

catalog_match.note: Grimes's wording is the inclusive form at the catalog rule's default lag 0, statement for statement

rules.merge_notes: Grimes writes 'entire range enclosed within the range of the previous bar', which the mining pass rendered inclusively (<=, >=) — that is `InsideBarInclusive(lag 0)`. The catalog's `InsideBar` is the STRICT form at lag 1 and remains a different rule: on tick-grid futures the two disagree on every bar that ties the prior high or low.

rules.description: The close sits in the upper fraction of the bar's own high-low range (long: buyers in control into the close); short is the mirror at the low.

catalog_match.note: the catalog rule verbatim, epsilon included; 0.75 is a threshold value, not a rule

rules.merge_notes: `CloseRangePosition(threshold, epsilon)` exactly. Grimes's default reading is 0.75 against the catalog's 0.5 — record the book value for the grid, nothing to author. His companion observation, that closes near the MIDDLE show no conviction, is the same rule negated on both placements, a per-placement toggle rather than a second rule.

rules.description: Every one of the last `runBars` bars closed in the top `threshold` of its own high-low range (short: the bottom) — Grimes's buying- or selling-climax run of bars closing at their extreme.
rules.pseudocode: CountIF((close - low) > threshold * (high - low + epsilon), runBars) >= runBars

complexity.reason: an all-of-N count over a per-bar ratio; no persistent state

catalog_match.note: a RUN of N bars, not one bar. ConsecutiveClosesBeyondEmaRun beside BarsBeyondEmaCount is the corpus precedent for keeping a run apart from its single-bar form. Not StrongBodyBarCountInWindow, which counts BODIES K-of-N rather than close position all-of-N

rules.merge_notes: One source, cited twice (the climax read, p72; the trend-leg checklist, p110). Product form `(close - low) > T x (high - low + eps)` so no division rounds, and a CountIF against the window length — the ExitOnFirstOppositeBodyAfterRun spelling — since EasyLanguage does not short-circuit.

dropped.reason: composition of BarRangeAtrMultiple (or BarRangeBelowAverageMultiple negated) + TrendDurationBars; 'near the end of a swing' is hindsight at the right edge, and the one mechanizable reading of it — the biggest bar of the run so far — is already the catalog's LargestTrendBarOfTheRun

bucket_summary: The smallest bucket: four candidates, three rules, one dropped. Two are flat duplicates of catalog rules (InsideBarInclusive at its default lag, CloseRangePosition with Grimes's 0.75 recorded as a book value for the grid). The one new rule is CloseRangePositionRun, the all-of-N form of CloseRangePosition that Grimes uses as a climax read, kept separate on the corpus's standing run-versus-single-bar precedent. It is the bucket's whole A list.
